headline: Millions Waiting Anxiously! Here Is the Figure Being Discussed for the Lowest Pension
summary: Pension and civil servant pay increases are being calculated from TÜİK's two-month inflation figure of 3.65 percent. Discussion focuses on the lowest pension level.
why: TÜİK is Turkey's statistics institute, and its inflation data drives wage indexation, pension adjustments and central bank policy expectations.
